<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918549_theRebbe_741" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918549_theRebbe_741__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection between the level of "Eisan" and Rashbi, who achieved ultimate unity with G-d, and how even his study of the revealed Torah was a drawing down of Divinity.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation of the matter</t>
    <t s="1">(the connection of the aspect of Eisan to Rashbi),</t>
    <t s="2">it is known,</t>
    <t s="3">that Eisan refers to the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="4">the aspect of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="5">which is united with Divinity in ultimate unity.</t>
    <t s="6">And this is the connection of Eisan to Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="7">for Rashbi was in ultimate unity,</t>
    <t s="8">as he said of himself, "I am merely a sign,"</t>
    <t s="9">"I am bound to Him, to the Holy One, blessed be He, with a single bond,"</t>
    <t s="10">"I am attached to Him, I am absorbed in Him, I am cleaved to Him"</t>
    <t s="11">[as explained in the notes of my master, my father,</t>
    <t s="12">the matter of the three expressions],</t>
    <t s="13">which is the nullification and unity that comes from the aspect of Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="14">And this is also that Rashbi was the source of the inner dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="15">the secrets of the Torah, which are the soul of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">and the secrets of secrets, which are the soul of the soul,</t>
    <t s="17">for within the soul of the soul, the aspect of Yechidah is also included.</t>
    <t s="18">Moreover, even his study of the revealed [Torah]</t>
    <t s="19">(in which most of his study consisted),</t>
    <t s="20">was in the manner of the study of the inner dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="21">a drawing down of Divinity from above to below.</t>
    <t s="22">For the difference between the revealed dimension of the Torah and the inner dimension of the Torah is,</t>
    <t s="23">that the revealed dimension of the Torah is clothed in physical matters in order to refine sparks,</t>
    <t s="24">but the inner dimension of the Torah is above clothing,</t>
    <t s="25">and the study of the inner dimension of the Torah is</t>
    <t s="26">(primarily not in order to refine sparks,</t>
    <t s="27">but rather)</t>
    <t s="28">to draw down supernal lights.</t>
    <t s="29">And by Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="30">even in his study of the revealed, the inner dimension shone,</t>
    <t s="31">to the point that even his study of the revealed was a drawing down of Divinity from above.</t>
    <t s="32">And this is the superiority of Rashbi over the other Tannaim,</t>
    <t s="33">for all the Tannaim,</t>
    <t s="34">their main occupation was either in the revealed dimension of the Torah or in the hidden dimension of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="35">For most of the Tannaim,</t>
    <t s="36">their main occupation was in the revealed dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="37">for the masters of Kabbalah were few,</t>
    <t s="38">and "Rav Yehudah—all his teaching was in [the tractate] Nezikin,"</t>
    <t s="39">for this part of the Torah is clothed in the most lowly matters of this physical world itself</t>
    <t s="40">(matters of damages,</t>
    <t s="41">claims of falsehood, etc.),</t>
    <t s="42">in order to also refine the sparks within these matters.</t>
    <t s="43">And those whose main occupation was in the hidden dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="44">the Work of the Chariot,</t>
    <t s="45">did not occupy themselves so much with the revealed.</t>
    <t s="46">Like Rabbi Nechunyah ben HaKaneh, who authored the book HaKaneh,</t>
    <t s="47">behold, in the revealed dimension of the Torah, only a little is brought from him.</t>
    <t s="48">But Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="49">in addition to the fact that his engagement in the inner dimension of the Torah was in a far more elevated manner,</t>
    <t s="50">drew the light of the inner dimension also into the revealed,</t>
    <t s="51">as is known</t>
    <t s="52">regarding the matter of "I wounded and I will heal,"</t>
    <t s="53">that through Rashbi, the partition between the revealed dimension of the Torah and the hidden dimension of the Torah was healed and nullified,</t>
    <t s="54">to the point that the revealed and the hidden are one.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the superiority of Rashbi over all Tannaim is incomparable, and therefore, to arouse influence from him, they needed to praise him.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, it will be understood that the superiority of Rashbi over all the Tannaim is an incomparable superiority,</t>
    <t s="2">therefore,</t>
    <t s="3">in order to arouse influence from him, they needed to praise him.</t>
    <t s="4">For the superiority of Yechidah over Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah-Chayah is an incomparable superiority,</t>
    <t s="5">and this is also understood from the fact that it is called Yechidah, a term of singular,</t>
    <t s="6">for the title "singular" indicates that there is no second to it.</t>
    <t s="7">For although Yechidah is also</t>
    <t s="8">(a spark)</t>
    <t s="9">a created being,</t>
    <t s="10">and all five levels</t>
    <t s="11">(including Yechidah)</t>
    <t s="12">belong to the soul that is clothed in the body and in the manner of "name," as the statement,</t>
    <t s="13">"Five names are called to her"</t>
    <t s="14">(to the soul in the body),</t>
    <t s="15">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="16">the essence of Yechidah is what it receives from the aspect of the Singular One,</t>
    <t s="17">a created spark whose essence is that within it is clothed a spark of the Creator.</t>
    <t s="18">And from this it is understood, all the more so, regarding the matter of the general Yechidah</t>
    <t s="19">(of the totality of the chain of descent, and all the more so)</t>
    <t s="20">of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="21">which is incomparably higher even than the soul of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="22">and certainly than the body of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="23">i.e., the laws of the Torah, which are called</t>
    <t s="24">"the bodies of the Torah."</t>
    <t s="25">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="26">in order to arouse the influence of Rashbi</t>
    <t s="27">(the aspect of Eisan,</t>
    <t s="28">Yechidah),</t>
    <t s="29">and particularly the inner dimension within this</t>
    <t s="30">(the concealment that is for its own sake),</t>
    <t s="31">so that it be drawn into the study of the Torah</t>
    <t s="32">(the revealed dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="33">even into Nezikin)</t>
    <t s="34">of the Tannaim, whose study</t>
    <t s="35">was in the manner of clothing to refine sparks,</t>
    <t s="36">they needed to praise him,</t>
    <t s="37">for to arouse an incomparable influence, it is through the precedence of praises,</t>
    <t s="38">as mentioned above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions how the praises of the Tannaim could affect Rashbi, and explains that it is because G-d desired a dwelling in the lower worlds, making the arousal from below effective.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">But it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="2">since Rashbi was separated in value from the other Tannaim, how could their praises affect him, to the point of arousing and renewing influence to them?</t>
    <t s="3">And even more so, it is not understood regarding the matter of praises with which they praise the Creator,</t>
    <t s="4">in order to arouse the will to bestow to creations,</t>
    <t s="5">behold, the arousal of the will is in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="6">[as understood from what is explained in many places,</t>
    <t s="7">that through praises, they arouse the will to be drawn down and clothed in the Sefiros],</t>
    <t s="8">and how can it be that our praises take hold in the Essence of Ein Sof?</t>
    <t s="9">And the matter regarding this is known,</t>
    <t s="10">that this—that the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations</t>
    <t s="11">(including the matter of praises)</t>
    <t s="12">arouses the drawing down—</t>
    <t s="13">is because it so arose in His will, blessed be He, that the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations should take hold before Him, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="14">Moreover, through the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations, there will be, as it were, a change in the light,</t>
    <t s="15">so that it be drawn down below to a place that is utterly incomparable,</t>
    <t s="16">even though from its own perspective, it is separate from this.</t>
    <t s="17">And one can say the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="18">that since the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="19">the matter of "desired" is above reason, as the Alter Rebbe said,</t>
    <t s="20">"On a desire, there is no question,"</t>
    <t s="21">behold, since the desire and delight of the Above is a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="22">in a lower world beneath which there is no lower,</t>
    <t s="23">therefore, the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations affects the light.</t>
    <t s="24">And seemingly, one should add,</t>
    <t s="25">that this is also why the vast majority of praises</t>
    <t s="26">(in the order of praise of the Omnipresent in Pesukei DeZimrah before prayer)</t>
    <t s="27">are about His influence, blessed be He, upon creations,</t>
    <t s="28">for</t>
    <t s="29">[in addition to the fact that the praise must be of the same kind as the influence one wishes to arouse,</t>
    <t s="30">and in order to arouse influence below, the praises must be about this matter,</t>
    <t s="31">behold]</t>
    <t s="32">by praising before Him, blessed be He, His influence to the lower creations,</t>
    <t s="33">through this, they arouse and reveal the delight in a dwelling place in the lower worlds.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
